name: resolution-bash
description: A2 name-resolution recall: each case exercises one link of the resolution chain (builtin → function → alias → external command → unknown). Every case must be classified as 'effect present or top', and the report must expose the decisive Resolution.Kind (which command the invocation actually named), with alias cases carrying a non-empty AliasChain. Both the bash and the POSIX (front/bash in the POSIX variant) dialects are covered (A6).

cases.note: an in-program alias: ll expands to ls -l, so resolution kind is alias with chain [ll]
a chained alias b → a → ls; the alias chain must list both links (b, a)
a shell builtin resolves to the builtin link of the chain
a state-mutating builtin also resolves to the builtin link of the chain
an external command with a KB signature resolves to the PATH link
an external destructive command also resolves through the PATH link
a name that matches nothing resolves to unknown and degrades to top (conservative)
A6: the same alias resolution in the POSIX variant
A6: builtin resolution in the POSIX variant
A6: external-command resolution in the POSIX variant
